title: Transport of common-stage descent and retract closure
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum] on small pro-etale sites. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$, and all morphisms are separated of finite type. Fix an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For $W=T,S$ write $\mathcal C_E(W)=D^b_c(W,E)$ for the raw rationalization of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and $\mathcal C_W$ for its common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Write $\mathcal P_E(W)$ and $\mathcal P_W$ for the distinct rational and pair categories of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category, def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Use their specified scalar extensions $T^{\mathrm{sf},W}_{F/E}$ and $T^{\mathrm{pbc},W}_{F/E}$ and scalar associators. Let $J_{W,E}:\mathcal C_E(W)\simeq\mathcal P_E(W)$ and $J_W:\mathcal C_W\simeq\mathcal P_W$ be the exact comparison equivalences of [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison], with coherent scalar comparisons $j_{W,F/E}:J_{W,F}T^{\mathrm{sf},W}_{F/E}\simeq T^{\mathrm{pbc},W}_{F/E}J_{W,E}$.

Let $\Phi_E:\mathcal C_E(T)\to\mathcal C_E(S)$ be exact functors for all intermediate fields $\mathbf Q_\ell\subset E\subset\Omega$ finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with exact natural isomorphisms
$$\beta_{F/E}:T^{\mathrm{sf},S}_{F/E}\Phi_E\xrightarrow{\sim}\Phi_F T^{\mathrm{sf},T}_{F/E}$$
satisfying the identity, scalar-associator and shift equations. There is an exact functor $\Phi:\mathcal C_T\to\mathcal C_S$ taking $(E,K)$ to $(E,\Phi_EK)$ and taking a common-stage arrow $[M,u]:(E,K)\to(F,L)$ to the class represented by
$$\beta_{M/F}^{-1}\circ\Phi_M(u)\circ\beta_{M/E}.$$
Scalar-compatible natural transformations between any two such families descend to natural transformations of these functors, and equations between compatible transformations descend. Under $J_T,J_S$, this functor is naturally isomorphic to the descent on $\mathcal P_T,\mathcal P_S$ of the transported family $J_{S,E}\Phi_EJ_{T,E}^{-1}$ with its scalar comparisons induced by $j$ and $\beta$. Finally the literal categories $\mathcal C_W$ with their common-stage shifts and triangles are idempotent-complete ordinary triangulated categories, and the finite-stage embeddings $D^b_c(W,E)\to\mathcal C_W$ are exact. No Karoubi envelope is inserted.

source.place: Clause (1): descent functors and idempotent-complete triangulation, transported through the coefficient-category comparison; returned item steps 9–10

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-coefficient-coherent-inverse to JT. It supplies exact inverse family H, finite equivalences HT with forward stages JT.family.Φ, and scalar-compatible inverse unit ν. Apply the same coefficient lemma to JS for forward finite-stage exactness. Its finite_shift and scalar_shift fields then give a coherent exact forward family. Compose H, F, JS to define G with finite functors HT inverse followed by F then JS. Its beta is the existing StageSystem.Morphism.comp beta. Naturality and the component scalar shift compatibility give the exact coherent composite. Whisker ν by F followed by JS to construct τ; its scalar square follows from ν.comm and naturality of the composite beta. Each τ component is invertible, with exactly the inverse-unit formula in the statement.

Apply prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors to G. Descend τ using StageSystem.Morphism.descNatTrans. At a pair (E,K) its component is the E-stage inclusion of τ_E,K, hence invertible. The natural isomorphism given by this descended transformation, composed with the canonical functorCompIso on both sides and the pair_functor equations, is F.functor followed by JS equivalence naturally isomorphic to JT equivalence followed by G.functor.

Give F.functor the shift induced from the just-constructed isomorphism by CommShift.ofComp, using full faithfulness of JS. CommShift.ofComp_compatibility makes this isomorphism commute with shifts. Functor.isTriangulated_iff_comp_right reflects exactness of JT followed by G through JS, proving F.functor exact, and hence additive. The representative formula is Morphism.functor_map_mkHom. Compatible transformation components, identity and composition are descNatTrans_app, descNatTrans_id and descNatTrans_comp. Equality of finite components gives equality after descending by natural-transformation extensionality. Thus the full DescentSpec F.base holds.

For W = T and S, the existing GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.isTriangulated and inclusion_exact already supply the prescribed triangulation and finite-stage exactness. Obtain idempotent completeness of the PBC pair category from thm-weil-pbc-idempotent-complete-triangulation; transfer it along J.equivalence.symm by Mathlib Idempotents.Equivalence.isIdempotentComplete. Assemble these conclusions with the constructed G, τ, descent assertions and natural isomorphism. No replacement shifts, categories or Karoubi objects are constructed.

tool_uses.why: Uses the specified exact equivalences and their scalar, inclusion, shift and triangle comparisons to transport the clause (1) PBC results to the distinct framework categories; this is a coefficient-category comparison tool, not a replacement of the unit route.

Generic equivalence transfer supplies triangulation witnesses; the specified comparisons identify the transported shifts and triangles with the literal common-stage ones. No coefficient-specific alternative proof is used.

The coefficient categories are kept distinct: framework raw rationalizations and C_W versus PBC ones with literal T_{E/E}=id, linked only by the J/j equivalences of lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison. Separated finite-type k-schemes are noetherian and finite-dimensional with ell invertible, so the comparison and PBC hypotheses hold. Step 1: triangles move across J_W, which identifies shifts and triangles; the idempotent splitting by fullness and faithfulness is correct; i_E is exact because J_W reflects triangles. Steps 2-3: I checked the directions of h and b and that b_{E/E}=1 literally (from the beta unit equation); the tower equation reduces to the j cocycle plus the beta tower; no linearity is used. Step 4 meets the hypotheses of the PBC descent node exactly. Step 5: I verified the key cancellation h∘H(j)∘eta_S = S(eta) after applying J, using naturality of epsilon and j and the triangle identities; it gives the stated representative formula. Step 6 is the naturality of tau at eta, and equations are reflected by faithful J_S. Duplicates: lem-sf-framework-common-stage-descent needs E-linear Phi_E (stronger hypothesis, correctly not used); lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent needs strict identity transitions. No new nodes, no cycle, no SGA, proof_deps equals the union of uses. I accept both tool uses (lem-fd comparison as the stmt_dep comparison; lem-pc triangulated-equivalence transfer as generic). No fixes.

Source and coefficient universes remain independent.
